28200.commentary: (VIN 1.4.2.8) jātarūpaṃ nāma satthuvaṇṇo vuccati. rajataṃ nāma kahāpaṇo lohamāsako dārumāsako jatumāsako ye vohāraṃ gacchanti. (MNa) jātarūparajatan'ti ettha pana jātarūpan'ti suvaṇṇaṃ. rajatan'ti yaṃkiñci vohār'ūpagaṃ lohamāsak'ādi.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jātarūparajataṃ uggaṇheyya vā uggaṇhāpeyya vā upanikkhittaṃ vā sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ, sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, paṭiggaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajatan'ti!

28201.meaning1: accepting gold and silver; receiving gold and money
28201.commentary: (MNa) jātarūpan'ti suvaṇṇaṃ. rajatan'ti kahāpaṇo lohamāsako jatumāsako dārumāsako'ti ye vohāraṃ gacchanti, tassa ubhayassa'pi paṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato, n'eva naṃ uggaṇhāti, na uggaṇhāpeti, na upanikkhittaṃ sādiyatī'ti attho

examples.text: jātarūpa-rajata-paṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, āmakadhaññapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, āmakamaṃsapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ
uccāsayana-mahāsayanā paṭivirato hoti, jātarūpa-rajata-paṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti
amu hi, bho gotama, puriso manasākaṭe jātasaṃvaddho, tassa sabbān'eva manasākaṭassa maggāni suviditānī'ti.
ekassa paccekabuddhassa jātassaraṃ oruyha nhāyantassa tīre ṭhapitesu kāsāvesu cīvaraṃ thenetvā tesaṃ hatthīnaṃ gaman'āgamanamagge sattiṃ gahetvā sasīsaṃ pārupitvā nisīdati

28206.meaning1: born and raised; born and grew up (in)
28206.commentary: (MNa) jātavaddho'ti jāto ca vaḍḍhito ca. yo hi kevalaṃ tattha jāto'va hoti, aññattha vaḍḍhito, tassa samantā gāmamaggā na sabbaso paccakkhā honti, tasmā jātavaddho'ti āha.

examples.text: taṃ, kiṃ maññasi māṇava, idh'assa puriso naḷakāragāme jātavaḍḍho, tam'enaṃ naḷakāragāmato tāva'd'eva avasaṭaṃ naḷakāragāmassa maggaṃ puccheyyuṃ

28207.meaning1: born and raised; born and grew up (in)
28207.commentary: (MNa) jātavaddho'ti jāto ca vaḍḍhito ca. yo hi kevalaṃ tattha jāto'va hoti, aññattha vaḍḍhito, tassa samantā gāmamaggā na sabbaso paccakkhā honti, tasmā jātavaddho'ti āha.

examples.text: taṃ, kiṃ maññasi māṇava, idh'assa puriso naḷakāragāme jātavaddho, tam'enaṃ naḷakāragāmato tāva'd'eva avasaṭaṃ naḷakāragāmassa maggaṃ puccheyyuṃ
khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ n'āparaṃ itthattāyā'ti pajānāti
ye kec'ime isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, kacci'ssu te bhagavā yaññapathe appamattā, atāruṃ jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.
devayānaṃ abhiruyha, virajaṃ so mahāpathaṃ, kāmarāgaṃ virājetvā, brahmalok'ūpago ahu, na naṃ jāti nivāresi, brahmalok'ūpapattiyā.
kiñci desaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāyā'ti leso nāma dasa lesā, jātileso, nāmaleso, gottaleso, liṅgaleso, āpattileso, pattaleso, cīvaraleso, upajjhāyaleso, ācariyaleso, sen'āsanaleso.
tena kho pana samayena brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo mithilāyaṃ paṭivasati jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto, vīsavassasatiko jātiyā, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū
kiṃ pana me samaṇo gotamo ime pañhe puṭṭho byākarissati! samaṇo hi gotamo daharo c'eva jātiyā, navo ca pabbajjāyā'ti.

28212.grammar: fem, abstr, in comps, from jāyati, irreg

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, sampanne sālikkhette set'aṭṭhikā nāma rogajāti nipatati, evaṃ taṃ sālikkhettaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti, evam'evaṃ kho, ānanda, yasmiṃ dhammavinaye labhati mātugāmo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ, na taṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti.

28213.meaning1: of nature; of type; of class; of category

examples.text: uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsakajātikā bhavissāmā'ti

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu, sutānañ'ca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti, dhātānañ'ca dhammānaṃ atth'ūpaparikkhī hoti attham'aññāya dhammam'aññāya, dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno hoti.

28214.commentary: (MNa) kā jāti etesan'ti kiṃjātikā. (MNa) piyajātikā'ti piyato jāyanti. piyappabhāvikā'ti piyato pabhavanti.

examples.text: ime ca, bhikkhave, cattāro upādānā. kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? ime cattāro upādānā taṇhānidānā taṇhāsamudayā taṇhājātikā taṇhāpabhavā.
piyajātikā hi, gahapati, soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā piyappabhavikā'ti.

28215.meaning2: belonging to clan, or nation of

examples.text: ime ca, bhikkhave, cattāro upādānā. kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? ime cattāro upādānā taṇhānidānā taṇhāsamudayā taṇhājātikā taṇhāpabhavā.

28218.meaning1: extinction of birth; wearing away of rebirth
28218.meaning2: destruction of the chance of being reborn

examples.text: tasmā upādānakkhayā, samma'd'aññāya paṇḍitā, jātikkhayaṃ abhiññāya, na gacchanti punabbhavan'ti.
pubbenivāsaṃ yo vedi, sagg'āpāyañ'ca passati, atho jātikkhayaṃ patto, abhiññā vosito muni.

28220.meaning1: extinction of birth; wearing away of rebirth

examples.text: kappāni viceyya kevalāni, saṃsāraṃ dubhayaṃ cut'ūpapātaṃ, vigatarajam'anaṅgaṇaṃ visuddhaṃ, pattaṃ jātikhayaṃ tam'āhu buddhan'ti.

28221.meaning1: who sees the wearing away and ending of birth; who observes the exhaustion and cessation of rebirth
28221.commentary: (ITIa) khayo eva anto'ti khay'anto, jātiyā khay'anto jātikhay'anto, nibbānaṃ. khayo vā maraṇaṃ, jātikhay'anto nibbānam'eva, tassa diṭṭhattā jātikhay'antadassī

examples.text: paripuṇṇasikkhaṃ apahānadhammaṃ, paññ'uttaraṃ jātikhay'antadassiṃ, taṃ ve muniṃ antimadehadhāriṃ, mārañ'jahaṃ brūmi jarāya pāraguṃ.
ek'āyanaṃ jātikhay'antadassī, maggaṃ pajānāti hit'ānukampī, etena maggena tariṃsu pubbe, tarissanti ye ca taranti oghan'ti.

28222.meaning2: seeing the destruction of (re-) birth, or, seeing the destruction of birth and death

28223.meaning1: birth and old age; being born and ageing

examples.text: so karohi dīpam'attano, khippaṃ vāyama paṇḍito bhava, niddhantamalo anaṅgaṇo, na punaṃ jātijaraṃ upehisi.
saṅkhāya lokasmiṃ paro'parāni, yass'iñjitaṃ n'atthi kuhiñci loke, santo vidhūmo anīgho nirāso, atāri so jātijaran'ti brūmī'ti.

28224.meaning2: employing the phrase 'birth and old age'

28225.meaning1: birth, old age, sickness and death
28225.compound: dvanda (jāti ca jarā ca byādhi ca maraṇa ca)

examples.text: yathā, mahārāja, samudde mataṃ kuṇapaṃ nicchubhīyati, evaṃ jinasāsanavare khalito paṇāmīyati. yaṃ pana te, mahārāja, tathāgato paṇāmesi, tesaṃ atthakāmo hitakāmo sukhakāmo visuddhikāmo evaṃ ime jātijarābyādhimaraṇehi parimuccissantī'ti paṇāmesī'ti.

28226.meaning1: overpowered by birth and old age; overwhelmed by being born and ageing

examples.text: sele yathā pabbatamuddhaniṭṭhito, yathā'pi passe janataṃ samantato, tath'ūpamaṃ dhammamayaṃ sumedho, pāsādam'āruyha samantacakkhu, sok'āvatiṇṇaṃ janatam'apetasoko, avekkhati jātijar'ābhibhūtan'ti.

28227.meaning1: birth, old age and death; being born, ageing and dying

examples.text: yattha atthi āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti, atthi tattha āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ. yattha atthi āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ, sasokaṃ taṃ, bhikkhave, sadaraṃ saupāyāsan'ti vadāmi.

28228.meaning1: generation of the arising of birth, old age, death and suffering
28228.meaning2: generation of the arising of birth, old age, death and suffering
28228.commentary: (MNa) jāti-jarā-maraṇa-dukkha-samudaya-sambhavo'ti jāti-jarā-maraṇassa c'eva avasesassa ca dukkhassa nibbatti na hotī'ti attho.
28228.sanskrit: jāti + jarā + maraṇa + duḥkha + samudaya + sambhava

examples.text: viññāṇañ'ca hi, ānanda, nāmarūpe patiṭṭhaṃ na labhissatha, api nu kho āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇa-dukkha-samudaya-sambhavo paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

28229.meaning2: generating birth, old age and death

28230.meaning1: leading to birth, old age, and death
28230.meaningLit: related to birth old age and death
28230.construction:
jāti + jarā + maraṇa + ika
jātijarāmaraṇa + ika

examples.text: iti kāmayogo bhavayogo diṭṭhiyogo avijjāyogo, saṃyutto pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi saṃkilesikehi ponobhavikehi sadarehi dukkhavipākehi āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇikehi.

yāni kho pana tāni pubbe attanā katāni pāpakāni kammāni saṃkilesikāni ponobhavikāni sadarāni dukkhavipākāni āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇikāni, tesaṃ vipāko mā nibbattī'ti n'atthi koci pāṭibhogo, samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ.

28231.meaning1: leading to birth, old age, and death
28231.construction:
jāti + jarā + maraṇa + iya
jātijarāmaraṇa + iya

examples.text: bāhit'āssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā
tathāgatassa, pāpima, ye āsavā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā, te pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.

28232.meaning1: headed to birth and old age; undergoing birth and old age; experiencing birth and old age
28232.commentary: (SNPa) jātijarūpagā'ti jātijaraṃ upagatā, jātijarāya vā upagatā, na parimuccanti jātijarāyā'ti evaṃ veditabbā.

examples.text: cetovimuttihīnā te, atho paññāvimuttiyā, abhabbā te antakiriyāya, te ve jātijar'ūpagā.
saritāni sinehitāni ca, somanassāni bhavanti jantuno, te sātasitā sukh'esino, te ve jātijar'ūpagā narā.

28233.meaning1: headed towards birth and old age; experiencing birth and old age

examples.text: ye keci kāmesu asaññatā janā, avītarāgā idha kāmabhogino, punappunaṃ jātijar'ūpagāmi te, taṇh'ādhipannā anusotagāmino.
ye keci kāmesu asaññatā janā, avītarāgā idha kāmabhogino, punappunaṃ jātijar'ūpagāhino, taṇh'ādhipannā anusotagāmino.

28235.meaning1: born from birth; produced by conception

examples.text: evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ, jarāmaraṇaṃ kho, āvuso, jātinidānaṃ jātisamudayaṃ jātijātikaṃ jātipabhavan'ti.

28236.meaning2: producing (further) birth, old age and death

28237.meaning2: undergoing birth, old age, and death; subject to birth, old age, and death

28238.meaning2: undergoing birth, old age, and death

28239.commentary: (SNPa) jātitthaddho nāma yo, ahaṃ jātisampanno'ti mānaṃ janetvā tena thaddho vātapūritabhastā viya uddhumāto hutvā na kassaci onamati. esa nayo dhanagottatthaddhesu.

examples.text: jātitthaddho dhanatthaddho, gottatthaddho ca yo naro, saññātiṃ atimaññeti, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.
tayo therā, jātithero, dhammathero, sammutithero.

28241.meaning1: liable to birth; of the nature to be born

examples.text: kiñ'ca, bhikkhave, jātidhammaṃ vadetha? puttabhariyaṃ, bhikkhave, jātidhammaṃ, dāsidāsaṃ jātidhammaṃ, aj'eḷakaṃ jātidhammaṃ, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ jātidhammaṃ
katamā ca, bhikkhave, anariyā pariyesanā? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammaṃ'y'eva pariyesati, attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhammaṃ'y'eva pariyesati

28242.meaning2: Chapter 4 of the Saḷāyatanasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 4 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

28243.meaningLit: group of ten discourses starting with the discourse on liable to birth

28244.commentary: (PMa) yasmā pana tassa jāti yathāvuttena atthena nidānañ'c'eva samudayo ca jāti ca pabhavo ca, tasmā jātinidānan'tiādim'āha.

examples.text: evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ, jarāmaraṇaṃ kho, āvuso, jātinidānaṃ jātisamudayaṃ jātijātikaṃ jātipabhavan'ti.

28245.meaning1: ending of birth; cessation of rebirth

examples.text: vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho, taṇhānirodhā upādānanirodho, upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā nirujjhanti.
jātisamudayā jarāmaraṇasamudayo jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇanirodho

28246.meaning1: leading to the ending of birth; leading to the cessation of conception

examples.text: yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako jātiñ'ca pajānāti, jātisamudayañ'ca pajānāti, jātinirodhañ'ca pajānāti, jātinirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti

28247.meaning1: suitable for leading to the end of birth

examples.text: so jātiñ'ca pajānāti, jātisamudayañ'ca pajānāti, jātinirodhañ'ca pajānāti, yā ca jātinirodhasāruppagāminī paṭipadā tañ'ca pajānāti, tathā paṭipanno ca hoti anudhammacārī, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabbaso sammā dukkhakkhayāya paṭipanno jātinirodhāya.

28248.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of jātipaccaya
28248.meaning1: dependent on birth; due to birth

examples.text: vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ

na kho, āvuso koṭṭhika, sayaṃkataṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ, na paraṃkataṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ, na sayaṃkatañ'ca paraṃkatañ'ca jarāmaraṇaṃ, n'āpi asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ. api ca, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇan'ti.

28249.meaning1: cliff of birth; precipice of becoming

examples.text: te jātisaṃvattanike'pi saṅkhāre abhisaṅkharitvā jarāsaṃvattanike'pi saṅkhāre abhisaṅkharitvā… jātipapātam'pi papatanti, jarāpapātam'pi papatanti

28250.meaning1: produced by conception; generated by birth

examples.text: sace maṃ, bhante, evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, jarāmaraṇaṃ, āvuso ānanda, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavanti? evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ, jarāmaraṇaṃ kho, āvuso, jātinidānaṃ jātisamudayaṃ jātijātikaṃ jātipabhavan'ti. evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ.

28251.meaning1: flame of birth; scorching heat of rebirth

examples.text: te jātisaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti … abhiratā … abhisaṅkharonti … abhisaṅkharitvā jātipariḷāhena'pi pariḍayhanti, jarāpariḷāhena'pi pariḍayhanti, maraṇapariḷāhena'pi pariḍayhanti, soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsa-pariḷāhena'pi pariḍayhanti.
yo ve avidvā upadhiṃ karoti, punappunaṃ dukkham'upeti mando, tasmā pajānaṃ upadhiṃ na kayirā, dukkhassa jātippabhav'ānupassī.
upadhinidānā pabhavanti dukkhā, ye keci lokasmim'anekarūpā, yo ve avidvā upadhiṃ karoti, punappunaṃ dukkham'upeti mando, tasmā pajānaṃ upadhiṃ na kayirā, dukkhassa jātippabhav'ānupassī'ti.

28254.meaning1: peril of birth; danger of rebirth
28254.commentary: (ANa) jātibhayan'ti jātiṃ ārabbha uppajjanakabhayaṃ. sesapadesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: katamāni cattāri? jātibhayaṃ, jarābhayaṃ, byādhibhayaṃ, maraṇabhayaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri bhayānī'ti.

ath'āparena ākārena bhayaṃ vuccati ajjhattikaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ bhayaṃ bhayānakaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso cetaso ubbego utrāso, jātibhayaṃ jarābhayaṃ byādhibhayaṃ maraṇabhayaṃ rājabhayaṃ corabhayaṃ aggibhayaṃ udakabhayaṃ att'ānuvādabhayaṃ par'ānuvādabhayaṃ daṇḍabhayaṃ duggatibhayaṃ ūmibhayaṃ…

28255.meaning1: from the same birthplace; from one's homeland; from one's native region

examples.text: atha kho sambahulā jātibhūmakā bhikkhū jātibhūmiyaṃ vassaṃvuṭṭhā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.

ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito, attanā ca app'iccho app'icchakathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā, attanā ca santuṭṭho santuṭṭhikathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

28257.meaning1: from the same birthplace; from one's homeland; from one's native region

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭh'aṃso suparikammakato paṇḍukambale nikkhitto bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca

28259.meaning1: of good birth; well-bred; from a good family
28259.commentary: (SNa) jātimā'ti yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā parisuddhāya jātiyā samannāgato.

examples.text: yuvā ca daharo c'āsi, paṭham'uppattiko susu, vaṇṇ'ārohena sampanno, jātimā viya khattiyo.

28260.meaning1: generated at birth; defined by birth
28260.commentary: (MNa) liṅgaṃ jātimayan'ti ajānantānam'pi ca tesaṃ jātimayam'eva saṇṭhānaṃ attano mūlabhūtatiṇ'ādisadisam'eva hoti.

examples.text: tiṇarukkhe'pi jānātha, na c'āpi paṭijānare, liṅgaṃ jātimayaṃ tesaṃ, aññam'aññā hi jātiyo.
te yogayuttā mārassa, ayogakkhemino janā, sattā gacchanti saṃsāraṃ, jātimaraṇagāmino.
jātimaraṇasaṃsāraṃ, ye vajanti punappunaṃ, itthabhāv'aññathābhāvaṃ, avijjāy'eva sā gati.
sattā gacchanti saṃsāraṃ, jātimaraṇagāmino, ye ca kāme pariññāya, bhavayogañca sabbaso.

28263.meaning1: dangers arising from birth and death; (or) the danger which is birth and death
28263.commentary: (ANa) jātimaraṇabhayassā'ti jātiñ'ca maraṇañ'ca paṭicca uppajjanakabhayassa, jātimaraṇasaṅkhātass'eva vā bhayassa.

examples.text: sammappadhānā māradheyy'ābhibhūtā, te asitā jātimaraṇabhayassa pāragū, te tusitā jetvā māraṃ savāhiniṃ te anejā, sabbaṃ namucibalaṃ upātivattā te sukhitā'ti.

28264.meaning1: eradication of birth and death; end of being born and dying

examples.text: upādāne bhayaṃ disvā, jātimaraṇasambhave, anupādā vimuccanti, jātimaraṇasaṅkhaye.

28265.commentary: (MNa) jātimaraṇasambhave'ti jātiyā ca maraṇassa ca kāraṇabhūte. (ANa) jātimaraṇasambhave'ti jātiyā ca maraṇassa ca sambhave paccayabhūte.

examples.text: upādāne bhayaṃ disvā, jātimaraṇasambhave, anupādā vimuccanti, jātimaraṇasaṅkhaye.

28266.compound: dvanda (jāti ca maraṇa ca saṃsāra ca)
28266.commentary: (SNPa) jātimaraṇasaṃsāran'ti khandhanibbattiṃ jātiṃ khandhabhedaṃ maraṇaṃ khandhapaṭipāṭiṃ saṃsārañ'ca.

examples.text: jātimaraṇasaṃsāraṃ, ye vajanti punappunaṃ, itthabhāv'aññathābhāvaṃ, avijjāy'eva sā gati.

28267.meaning1: of nature; of type; of class; of category
28267.meaning2: being of such a kind, of such a class(?) or type of birth, class, lineage(?)

examples.text: yasmiṃ padese kappeti, vāsaṃ paṇḍitajātiyo, sīlavant'ettha bhojetvā, saññate brahmacārayo.

28268.commentary: (ANa) jātiyāvane'ti sayaṃjāte aropite himavantena saddhiṃ ek'ābaddhe vanasaṇḍe, taṃ nagaraṃ upanissāya tasmiṃ vane viharatī'ti attho.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu bhaddiye jātiyāvane divāvihāragato nipanno hoti. tassa aṅgam'aṅgāni vātūpatthaddhāni honti.

28269.commentary: (VINa) jātileso nāma khattiyo diṭṭho hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto. aññaṃ khattiyaṃ passitvā codeti, khattiyo mayā diṭṭho

examples.text: kiñci desaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāyā'ti leso nāma dasa lesā, jātileso, nāmaleso, gottaleso, liṅgaleso, āpattileso, pattaleso, cīvaraleso, upajjhāyaleso, ācariyaleso, sen'āsanaleso.
vīsam'pi jātiyo tiṃsam'pi jātiyo cattālīsam'pi jātiyo paññāsam'pi jātiyo jātisatam'pi, jātisahassam'pi jātisatasahassam'pi
vīsam'pi jātiyo tiṃsam'pi jātiyo cattālīsam'pi jātiyo paññāsam'pi jātiyo jātisatam'pi, jātisahassam'pi jātisatasahassam'pi

28273.meaning1: source of birth; arising of conception

examples.text: yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako jātiñ'ca pajānāti, jātisamudayañ'ca pajānāti, jātinirodhañ'ca pajānāti, jātinirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti

28274.meaning1: with birth as source; originating from being born

examples.text: evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ, jarāmaraṇaṃ kho, āvuso, jātinidānaṃ jātisamudayaṃ jātijātikaṃ jātipabhavan'ti.

28275.meaning1: of noble birth; born in a good family
28275.meaning2: of good birth or a noble family

examples.text: khattiyaṃ jātisampannaṃ, abhijātaṃ yasassinaṃ, daharo'ti n'āvajāneyya, na naṃ paribhave naro.

28276.meaning1: of royal lineage; of noble birth

examples.text: rājā'va khattiyo muddh'āvasitto jātisampanno, bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo, ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpā'ssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhātā vacasā paricitā manas'ānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā

28277.meaning1: production of birth; generation of rebirth

examples.text: evaṃ ce sattā jāneyyuṃ, dukkh'āyaṃ jātisambhavo, na pāṇo pāṇinaṃ haññe, pāṇaghātī hi socatī'ti.

28278.meaning2: confusion of classes or rank; contamination of class

examples.text: te jātisambhedabhayā sakāhi bhaginīhi saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ kappesuṃ.
vīsam'pi jātiyo tiṃsam'pi jātiyo cattālīsam'pi jātiyo paññāsam'pi jātiyo jātisatam'pi, jātisahassam'pi jātisatasahassam'pi

28281.meaning1: birth and wandering on; cycle of rebirth; endless rebirth

examples.text: ucchinnabhavataṇhassa, santacittassa bhikkhuno, vikkhīṇo jātisaṃsāro, n'atthi tassa punabbhavo'ti.
anekajātisaṃsāraṃ, sandhāvissaṃ anibbisaṃ, gahakārakaṃ gavesanto, dukkhā jāti punappunaṃ.

28282.meaning1: leading to birth; resulting in rebecoming

examples.text: te jātisaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti, jarāsaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti, maraṇasaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti, soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsa-saṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti.

28283.meaningLit: group of ten discourses beginning with the discourse on birth

28286.meaning1: discussion about (the purity of one's) birth; account of one's birth; talk about ancestry
28286.commentary: (ANa) kena kāraṇenā'ti? jātivādena. iti'pi hīnajātiko eso'ti evarūpena vacanenā'ti attho.

examples.text: khattiyo nāma ubhato sujāto hoti, mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko, yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakuṭṭho jātivādena.
ye hi keci ambaṭṭha jātivādavinibaddhā vā gottavādavinibaddhā vā mānavādavinibaddhā vā āvāhavivāhavinibaddhā vā, ārakā te anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya.

28288.meaning1: division of species; classification of types; taxonomy (of)
28288.meaning2: division or classification of species or kinds

examples.text: tesaṃ vo ahaṃ byakkhissaṃ, anupubbaṃ yathātathaṃ, jātivibhaṅgaṃ pāṇānaṃ, aññam'aññāhi jātiyo.

28290.meaning1: from humble background; of low rank

examples.text: samaṇaṃ mātā pitā bhātā, vandanti naṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ, samaṇ'īdha jātihīnaṃ, abhivādenti khattiyā'ti.

28291.meaning1: ever; at all; at any time; (comm) certainly; undoubtedly

examples.text: dhitipparaṃ kiṃ mama citta kāhisi, na te alaṃ citta vas'ānuvattako, na jātu bhastaṃ ubhatomukhaṃ chupe, dhi'r'atthu pūraṃ nava sotasandaniṃ.
diṭṭhiñ'ca anupaggamma, sīlavā dassanena sampanno, kāmesu vineyya gedhaṃ, na hi jātu gabbhaseyya punaretī'ti.

iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.

28293.meaning1: I am the kind of person

28294.synonym: ājānanta, ñū, dassī, lakkhika, vijāna, vidū

examples.text: dujjānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, bhante, bhagavato vā jīvit'antarāyānaṃ, mayhaṃ vā jīvit'antarāyānaṃ. desetu me, bhante bhagavā, dhammaṃ, desetu, sugato, dhammaṃ, yaṃ mam'assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā'ti.
dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, tayā aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatr'āyogena aññatr'ācariyakena, saññā purisassa attā'ti vā, aññā'va saññā añño attā'ti vā'ti.

28296.grammar: prp, masc instr sg of jānanta, trans (+acc)

examples.text: ayaṃ loko paro loko, jānatā suppakāsito, yañ'ca mārena sampattaṃ, appattaṃ yañ'ca maccunā.

28297.meaning1: when knowing and seeing; for one who knows and sees

examples.text: duddasaṃ anataṃ nāma, na hi saccaṃ sudassanaṃ, paṭividdhā taṇhā jānato, passato n'atthi kiñcanan'ti.
tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kām'āsavā'pi cittaṃ vimuccati bhav'āsavā'pi cittaṃ vimuccati avijj'āsavā'pi cittaṃ vimuccati
